versions.subject: rule: Exploiting SetupComplete.cmd CVE-2019-1378
versions.detection:
selection:
    ParentCommandLine: 
        - '*\cmd.exe /c C:\Windows\Setup\Scripts\SetupComplete.cmd'
        - '*\cmd.exe /c C:\Windows\Setup\Scripts\PartnerSetupComplete.cmd'
filter:
    Image: 
        - 'C:\Windows\System32\\*'
        - 'C:\Windows\SysWOW64\\*'
        - 'C:\Windows\WinSxS\\*'
        - 'C:\Windows\Setup\\*'
condition: selection and not filter
